usage: Used as a general countable/uncountable noun for the genre of electronic music; it sounds natural in everyday speech and writing.
Commonly appears after verbs like 聽, 播, 喜歡, and 玩, when talking about listening to or making music.
Can refer broadly to EDM-style music, synth-based music, or any music made mainly with electronic instruments and production.
In casual Hong Kong Cantonese, people often shorten or pair it with genre labels, such as house, techno, or chill electronic sounds.
